fail.name: Frightened (Baleful Presence)
fail.desc: Frightened of the Druid until the end of its next turn.

success.name: Immune to Baleful Presence
success.desc: Succeeded on the save — immune to this Druid's Baleful Presence for 24 hours.

automation.text: **Once per turn**, when you hit a creature with a melee attack while your **Entropic Shroud** is active, it makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure it is **Frightened** of you until the end of its next turn. A creature that succeeds is immune to your Baleful Presence for 24 hours.
